chunks: 22 - They also narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that he described the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and he wiped over his feet.
ai.seo_question: What does the narration of Ibn 'Abbas say about wiping the feet in the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This report states that Ibn 'Abbas described the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله as including wiping over the feet. It is cited in the context of explaining the manner and rulings of wudu (ablution).
